specs.title: B2BP-PROGRAMMING-002 Publish/assignment rejects empty or incomplete steps with actionable step/field issues
B2BP-PROGRAMMING-011 Trainer can set per-step reviewed/block policy and sees target dose/notice without a grading workflow
B2BP-PROGRAMMING-008 Period move previews affected eligibility/logs/date overrides; apply is audited and atomic with expected revisions
B2BP-PROGRAMMING-005 Goal objective, explicit timezone confirmation, gaps, past/current/future stages and repeated routine references persist
B2BP-PROGRAMMING-006 Two slots on one day remain two obligations; simultaneous enrollments stay distinct
B2BP-PROGRAMMING-007 Publishing/archive/reuse retain stable routine IDs and immutable issued versions
B2BP-PROGRAMMING-004 Invalid min/max/numeric bounds, incomplete or reversed dates and overlapping/out-of-order stages are rejected
B2BP-PROGRAMMING-010 Account/brand/branch switch hides the prior draft and prevents a late response restoring it
B2BP-PROGRAMMING-012 Date/range controls work with keyboard and touch at 320px without horizontal overflow
B2BP-ROLES-001 Unassigned same-branch coach reads roster/history, edits planning and assigns a routine
B2BP-ROLES-002 Foreign tenant, foreign branch, foreign resource ID and ambiguous branchless requests are denied
B2BP-ROLES-003 Superadmin creates admins/coaches/members; admin creates only coaches/members; no self-escalation
B2BP-ROLES-005 Accepted planning/permission mutations show actor, bounded changed fields, server time, request and revision; exact replay adds no audit
B2BP-ROLES-008 Queued write after grant revocation is denied; another branch's higher role does not authorize this branch
B2BP-ROLES-007 Inactive member remains a historical training target and is rejected as active planning target
B2BP-ROLES-004 Last-superadmin loss and platform/operator promotion are denied
B2BP-ROLES-006 Audit drawer is scoped, keyboard accessible and omits raw health/actual payloads
B2BP-ROLES-009 Unified and WL paths enforce host/domain generation and selected branch identically
